changelog:
Initial release of dfw-content-calendar: generate structured, ready-to-schedule social media content calendars for any niche.

- Instantly creates 7-day (free) or 30-day (premium) content calendars with varied hooks, body text, CTAs, and hashtags per post
- Supports single or multi-platform scheduling (LinkedIn, X/Twitter, Facebook, Instagram)
- Outputs in human-readable, structured JSON, or CSV formats for direct scheduler import
- Premium features: full 30-day calendars, A/B hook variants, CSV export, weekly theme override, multi-platform runs
- Ensures topic variety, platform-specific formatting, and five-pillar content mix for maximum engagement
summary: Generate 7- or 30-day social media calendars with hooks, body copy, CTAs, and hashtags tailored by niche, audience, and platform in JSON or CSV formats.
